contract.pre_score_admission: exposure_weight must be admitted before current block_score is observable
contract.same_history: if K_t<=K_cap, current row enters same-history V3 streams and exact nine-split minimax numerical bounds may be reported
contract.handoff: first K_t>K_cap is latched before current score; that exact row enters neither reporting certificate
contract.fresh: fresh split is frozen from pre-fresh history and residual alpha; only rows strictly after the handoff row enter fresh V3 streams
contract.weight_identity: incremental SHA-256 hash chain binds every prefix to its predictable exposure-weight sequence
contract.alpha: same-history phase spends at most m(K_cap)*delta_same and fresh phase at most residual delta_fresh; no reset

independent_state_machine_stress.model: production-V3 denominator/log-e recreated independently; 40 deterministic prefixes; equal-process weight=1, exposure weight alternates .25,1; block_score=0; mu0=.05; K_cap=5; delta_global=.05; delta_same=.025
independent_state_machine_stress.interpretation: The first guard-failing row is excluded from both certificate phases and the next row is the first fresh-confirm observation.

scope: The independent stress reproduces the mathematical state machine and production V3 formulas but is not a byte-execution of the persisted wrapper module.
The wrapper is not yet connected to the durable planned-slot journal; pre-score admission ordering must be enforced by that integration rather than inferred from row contents after the fact.
The hybrid theorem applies only inside the declared safe parameter domain and with predictable weights.
Full null/off-target Monte Carlo for lifetime numerical miscoverage and reporting delay remains pending.
